settings.heading: Product features
settings.content:
• Integrated Folding Design: No installation required—simply unfold and use. The lightweight frame folds compactly for effortless storage and portability.
  • Soundproof Cloth Stitching: The frame and mattress are joined with sound-absorbing fabric, minimizing movement noise and ensuring restful, undisturbed sleep.
  • Premium Build Quality: Features thickened metal accessories, oxford cloth supports, and non-slip foot pads for extra durability and user safety.

settings.heading: Materials and care
settings.content:
• Frame: High-grade steel pipe with flush connection technology for precise support, strong load-bearing, and long-lasting durability.
  • Mattress: High-resilience cotton/foam filling encased in breathable plaid fabric or durable oxford cloth for comfort and health.
  • Upholstery: Cover is soft, sweat-absorbent, and non-irritating to skin. It is designed for all-season use, resisting pilling and maintaining shape.
  • Non-Slip Foot Pads: Provide additional safety on a variety of surfaces and protect flooring from scratches.

Care Instructions:

  • Clean with a soft brush or vacuum regularly to remove dust from the
{{ block.settings.page.content }}
  • surface.
  • Spot-clean spills with a damp cloth, using mild detergent if necessary.
  • Allow fabric to air dry naturally; avoid exposure to excessive moisture or direct sunlight for long periods.
  • Do not use bleach or abrasive cleaners.
  • Store folded bed in a dry, ventilated area when not in use.
